name: g-min-amethyst
setup: bend.set('camera', { followDist: 1.9, followFov: 40, followPitch: 0.08, followSwing: 0 }); bend.wake(); bend.place(0,0,0,Math.PI/2); bend.loadout(0, { layers: [{ kind: 'gems', share: 1, params: { suite: 'amethyst', crystals: 1 } }] }); await bend.step(90);
